description: Capability for the cockpit in the main window. The cockpit is served by the local backend over http, which Tauri treats as a remote origin: without an explicit remote entry that page gets no capability at all, and without the app's own allow-* permissions (generated by the app manifest in build.rs) every app command is refused with 'not allowed by ACL'. Either way the app-side readers silently fall back to the backend (measured 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-25). Pane windows (label pane-<hex of the session name>) load the same cockpit page in solo mode and get the same grants; the pane-window commands let the cockpit open, focus and close them (2026-09-29). Tour checklist windows reuse the pane- label prefix and are opened, closed and looked up by the tour-window commands (2026-10-04).
